_about: Files that may name localStorage or sessionStorage. Read by eslint.config.mjs (no-restricted-globals) and by npm run test:story-data-registry. New code stores through the storage module or the intake store; 'existing' lists older files with what they keep, to move here over time. Never add to 'existing'.

allowed.src/lib/case-system/storage/: The storage module: the registry, the reset and the legacy-key cleanup.
allowed.app/_components/IntakeRecovery.tsx: The intake store: the tab's copy of the intake record.

existing.app/_components/HomeLocationGate.tsx: Writes the home page's hand-off into the intake record's session slot.
existing.app/_components/startSignIn.ts: Marks the guest intake to carry at sign-in (guestCarry.ts).
existing.app/builder/_components/CourtAssistantCh: The follow-up chat transcript and its route transfer.
existing.app/builder/page.tsx: The last-saved case id for this tab, the finder hand-off, and the shared-key cleanup.
existing.app/cases/[id]/drafts/page.tsx: Moves drafts kept only in this browser before drafts were saved to the account, then removes them.
existing.app/login/page.tsx: Reads and rewrites the intake record's session slot at sign-in.
Whether the person accepted the first-use notice.
